title: CyTOF analysis code for: Epigenetic Heterogeneity in Breast Tumors with Implications for Disease Diagnosis and Monitoring
description:
Jupyter notebooks and supporting Python packages implementing the single-cell epigenetic CyTOF analysis reported in Furth, Riemenschneider, Arieli et al. Includes ECDF quantile batch correction, core-histone normalization, UMAP/DBSCAN subpopulation identification, XGBoost/SHAP classification, PermCell permutation-calibrated signature scoring, and Vendi diversity scoring.

Raw CyTOF measurements are deposited separately at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15336152.
